name: User Expresses Distrust in Confidentiality
goal: Check bot's reassurance when user doubts the confidentiality of HR conversations.
constraints: Bot should reassure the user about confidentiality and explain data privacy policies.

phases.description: User expresses concern about sharing personal information due to confidentiality doubts.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot reassures user and explains confidentiality measures.

phases.description: User requests to see the company data privacy policy.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot provides a summary or link to the official privacy policy.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
